request.query: What is the default value, limit, requirement, or documented behavior of `test.concurrent`?
request.instructions: A passage answers only if it itself states a concrete value, limit, version, or rule for `test.concurrent`. A passage that only mentions the name, or only uses it in an example without stating a rule, does not answer.

documents.title: docs/CLI.md > Reference > `--maxConcurrency=<num>`
documents.text:
### `--maxConcurrency=<num>`

Prevents Jest from executing more than the specified amount of tests at the same time. Only affects tests that use `test.concurrent`.

documents.title: docs/Configuration.md > Reference > `maxConcurrency` \[number]
documents.text:
### `maxConcurrency` \[number]

Default: `5`

A number limiting the number of tests that are allowed to run at the same time when using `test.concurrent`. Any test above this limit will be queued and executed once a slot is released.
